title: Expose visible held and worn items on People here in room-context and get_players_in_area without leaking stowed inventory

sections.what: Expose visibly held hand-slot items (hand_left, hand_right) and outer worn clothing on People here in get_players_in_area() and room-context.ts by reusing get_visible_equipment(), while stopping engine/area_description.py from leaking stowed EDGE_CARRYING items to bystanders.
sections.why: Currently engine/player_manager.py get_players_in_area() omits equipped/held gear entirely and room-context.ts People here prints no held items, so entering a room where someone is holding a gun gives Actor prompts zero perception of the weapon. Conversely, engine/area_description.py loops over both EDGE_EQUIPPED and EDGE_CARRYING, treating held items as worn and leaking unequipped pocket items.
sections.how:
1. Reuse engine/equipment.py:get_visible_equipment() (from task-516, which already filters concealed, worn layering, and current_state hidden) to split visible active hand slots (hand_left, hand_right) from outer worn items.
2. Populate structured holding and wearing fields on each character entry returned by engine/player_manager.py get_players_in_area(), gated by area lighting/visibility.
3. Update engine/area_description.py lines 495-574 so bystanders see only get_visible_equipment() items and never unequipped stowed EDGE_CARRYING inventory.
4. Update static/js/agent/prompt-builder/room-context.ts People here formatter (lines 718-743) to render visible held items cleanly (distinct from relationship/appearance prose).
sections.verify:
1. Run pytest checking get_players_in_area(), get_visible_equipment(), and engine/area_description.py when NPC B holds a hand_right item and carries stowed EDGE_CARRYING and concealed items across bright and dim lighting.
2. Run JS unit tests for room-context.ts confirming People here surfaces held items and hides stowed inventory.

acceptance.text: get_players_in_area() reuses engine/equipment.py get_visible_equipment (or shared visibility helper) to expose visible hand-held items (hand_left/hand_right) and outer worn clothing while respecting concealed and hidden gating and never exposing unequipped stowed EDGE_CARRYING items.
room-context.ts People here formatting displays visible hand-held items under sufficient lighting so Actor prompts and ThreatDetector observe weapons or tools held by nearby characters.
engine/area_description.py aligns with task-516 visibility rules so unequipped stowed EDGE_CARRYING pocket/bag items of bystanders are not leaked in room prose.

Intended UI home: Prompt Preview and Agent Turn Modal context inspector (static/js/agent/prompt-builder/room-context.ts output).

Current availability: Prompt Preview renders People here lines from players_in_area, omitting held weapons/tools while engine/area_description.py still exposes EDGE_CARRYING items alongside EDGE_EQUIPPED.

Manual verification steps:
1. Place two characters in a lit area, with character B wielding an item (e.g. pistol) in hand_right and stowing a concealed or pocket item via EDGE_CARRYING.
2. Inspect character A's Prompt Preview / People here section.
   - expected: Character B's entry reports the held item and omits stowed pocket or concealed items.
